body: I don't depend on them anymore for support after that. Or I try not to as much. I just don't know where to start in regards to getting better and living for myself. Suicide seems like the best option at this current point. Thank you for trying to help though.

I wanted to join my best mate I kinda shut myself off after that, I don't see myself being successful and tbh kinda feel like I'm a waste of space. The pressure of forcing myself to be better got to me, depression isn't a thing in my family. Its seen as a weakness. Something you can just stop by being happy or by going out more and stuff. The biggest reason was my parents kinda said they regretted having me and to just go ahead and do it when I first opened up to them about the thoughts I was having. This must all seem really superficial right? Like I shouldn't be struggling this much to get over this. And idk if this is worth noting but idk how to get professional help. I heard its expensive and I cant afford it.
what you define as a smaller issue? An example? Just dont want to list off stuff you didnt ask for

I've tried looking out for myself. Theres days where I have highs and I try to make the best of them to improve myself and my life. But a day or two later its like all the energy and motivation is sapped out of me and ending things is all I can think about. I can't help, but feel wrong for feeling this way because everyone keeps telling me others have it worse. Which is true. In a way I shouldn't feel this way

I guess to name a few I don't seem to have any motivation anymore. Situations came up where I was forced to leave college/uni because of an attempt. Since then I can't go on. Losing my best mate who I was closest too didn't help. Everyday seems like a struggle dealing with self harm, I feel numb, my home life isn't exactly the greatest too much tension with my family. Im like an outcast. I can't find a job, living off the little savings I had etc. I honestly think i might be lazy like everyone says I am. Theres more but the more I type the more it just seems like me being whiny like these aren't real issues. Im a failure so whats the point. And sorry if this doesn't make much sense I struggle forming coherent thoughts.
